description.text:
The Four-Party Connection gift boxes (四方联结) came out on 19 January 2024 and brought Pokémon V-UNION to the Simplified Chinese game. A V-UNION is one Pokémon printed across four cards. They can't be played from the hand: once all four are in your discard pile, they are put together on your Bench as one Pokémon with high HP and up to four attacks, worth three Prize cards when Knocked Out, and each V-UNION can come into play only once a game.

Three boxes each held the four cards of one V-UNION, Mewtwo, Greninja or Zacian, with a small binder holding up to 128 cards. The Morpeko set box (套装礼盒) held two sets of Morpeko V-UNION, one regular and one with special art of Morpeko alongside Marnie, with a binder, a card box, 64 sleeves and six 5-card Primordial Arts packs. The Pikachu Gathering box (皮卡丘大集合) held a Pikachu V-UNION whose art fits in 25 Pikachu, four Primordial Arts packs and a frame to show the four cards, the first frame for hanging on a wall made for the Simplified Chinese game; its Pikachu cards are listed with the Sword & Shield promos.
